children: Technology solutions firm's Q3 revenue rose 2.5% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted operating profit margin for Q3 improved to 7.2%
Company raised full-year constant currency revenue guidance, reaffirmed profit margin outlook
Unisys raises 2026 full-year constant currency revenue growth guidance to (3.0)% to (1.5)%
Company reaffirms 2026 full-year non-GAAP operating profit margin guidance of 9.0% to 11.0%
Company expects 2026 reported revenue growth of (0.4)% to 1.1%
NEW BUSINESS SIGNINGS - Co said strong new business signings and expanding client interest contributed to Q3 results
CLEARPATH SOFTWARE MIX - Co attributed improved gross profit margin to higher mix of software licenses in ClearPath renewals
ECS PROJECT WORK - Enterprise Computing Solutions revenue growth was driven by increased specialized project work
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Unisys Corporation is $5.00, about 111.9% above its November 3 closing price of $2.36
The stock recently traded at 3 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 3 three months ago
